summary: Iteration_8 (both). BACKEND (5/5 new pytest passing in /app/backend/tests/test_batch2_formation_rename.py): (1) GET /army/suggest (qa.lord) returns full schema (formation dict, picks[] with key/name/owned/cost/per_command/counter_pct/quantity, army_power, current_army_power, command_used=40 ≤ command_capacity=1980, formation_slots=3, stage=48, region 'Iron Hills', kind 'normal', enemy_mix, required_power=649, hero_power=1093); every unit type in formation has quantity ≤ owned; types_used ≤ formation_slots. (2) GET /army/suggest?stage=50 → kind='boss', stage=50. (3) PUT /army/formation with the suggested formation → 200; subsequent GET /army shows formation applied; original restored after. (4) PATCH /account/settings {display_name:'QA Temp'} → 200, GET /profile display_name updated; then restored to 'QA Lord' (canonical) confirmed via GET /profile. (5) POST /battle/attempt {stage:50} for orsi.bot1 returns attempt.kind='boss' with timeline.waves[0..9]; last wave t_start=52.0/t_end=80.0, boss_dur=28s / total 80s = 0.35 EXACTLY (spec ~35% ✓). FRONTEND (390x844): all main new-batch flows verified. Battle scene (qa.lord, Auto ON, stage 47): battle-scene renders, sprite VFX Images present inside the scene (29-37 including formation-proxies, lord-art, monster-art plus VFX sprites), formation-proxies animates, super-aura+ultimate-wave+skill-banner ('POTENZA MASSIMA' observed) fire, combo-counter (up to x30 seen), army-counter-net + super-gauge present, NO 360° rotation on the Lord over 10s of observation (transform rotation stayed 0°). Zoom controls battle-zoom-zoom-in / battle-zoom-zoom-out visible under the HUD on the scene's right; after tapping zoom-in twice a battle-zoom-zoom-reset appears and resets. NO console errors, only pre-existing 401 fetch noise + pointerEvents deprecation warnings. Boss special move (orsi.bot1, stage 50 Mountain Tyrant): tutorial dismissed; the currently-running battle entered its boss wave (Ondata 10/10) after ~50s of scene-time; testID boss-warning rendered with exact text '⚠ MOSSA SPECIALEFrana' (rock slam) and boss-bar visible; warning persisted across 60s of polling (every ~7s, matches spec), boss glow + huge red damage numbers visible near the Lord (loss path). required-power overlay does not overlap boss-warning position (top vs mid-scene). Lord rename (qa.lord): rename-lord-button → rename-sheet + rename-input, typed 'Lord QA Test' → rename-save-button → toast 'Nome del Lord aggiornato' + hero card updated; renamed back to canonical 'QA Lord' (verified persisted via /profile). Formation area (/army/formation): formation-screen renders formation-preview with region background + lord + unit sprites + enemy mix chips (Umanoidi 25% / Corazzati 50% / Volanti 25% for stage 48), formation-stats shows formation-power (1673→1041 pre/post), formation-types (2/3), formation-command (40/1980→25/1980), all steppers formation-plus-/minus/plus10/max/zero present for infantry+archer (owned tiers), formation-qty- updates on tap (infantry 5→6 verified), suggest-formation-button → suggestion-panel with apply-suggestion-button + edit-suggestion-button; tapping apply-suggestion-button applies and shows toast 'Formazione schierata'. formation-preview-zoom-in/out functional. Also open-formation-button EXISTS in Battle hero card AND Army tab bottom panel. UI zoom (ZoomPill ui-zoom-bar): value goes 100% → 110% on ui-zoom-bar-in tap and returns to 100% on ui-zoom-bar-out; value persists across navigation to /profile where ui-zoom-profile shows same '110%' value and 'Zoom interfaccia' row is visible. On stack Screens the header pill uses default testID 'ui-zoom' (NOT 'ui-zoom-bar') — that's spec-consistent since 'ui-zoom-bar' is the ResourceBar-scoped instance. Scene zoom (all working): kingdom-zoom-zoom-in/reset (building-castle still tappable at 100%, opens sheet with 'Livello / Potenzia'), domain-zoom-zoom-in/out present after ~5s domain map load, war-zoom-zoom-in on /alliance/war (war-node-21 still tappable after zoom), titan-zoom-zoom-in on /alliance/boss. Regression: /hero/gear renders 53 images (equipped + inventory art intact), Profile shows only 'Musica' audio control (Effetti sonori absent), Kingdom walls perimeter ring still present, Army tab still shows Forte/Debole lines per unit card. Only anomaly worth mentioning below is a display-side timing quirk on the Battle tab stage label (see design_issues) — the stage-panel picker shows the NEXT stage while the running-battle scene banner shows the currently-attempted stage, which is spec-correct but visually confusing when they differ.

issues: The boss-warning text renders as '⚠ MOSSA SPECIALEFrana' with no space/break between 'SPECIALE' and the move name — the two Text spans are concatenated. Consider adding a space or a line-break between them ('⚠ MOSSA SPECIALE · Frana' or on two lines). See /app/frontend/src/battle/BattleScene.tsx (boss-warning render).

design_issues.screen: Battle tab stage picker vs scene banner
issues: When an attempt is server-running, the stage-panel picker shows the NEXT stage (Stage 50 for orsi.bot1) while the scene banner shows the currently-running stage (Stage 49 · Ondata 10/10). Both are correct individually but visually confusing. Consider showing 'In corso: Stage X' next to the picker when active.

action_items: Minor copy polish: separate 'MOSSA SPECIALE' from the move name in boss-warning (currently reads 'MOSSA SPECIALEFrana' without a space) — likely a missing space between two <Text> spans in BattleScene.tsx.

Optional UX polish: on the Battle tab when a server attempt is running, echo the running stage next to the stage-panel picker so the picker's NEXT stage doesn't visually contradict the scene banner's current stage.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /army/suggest correctly enforces command budget and slot count: for qa.lord command_used=40 ≤ command_capacity=1980 and 2 unit types ≤ 3 slots, all qty ≤ owned.
PUT /army/formation reflects back in GET /army immediately (single-source-of-truth), and PATCH /account/settings display_name is durable across GET /profile.
Boss wave timing is EXACTLY 35% for stage-50 orsi.bot1 attempt (t_start=52.0, t_end=80.0, duration=80) — perfectly matches spec.

Battle scene wires sprite-based VFX as <Image> children inside battle-scene (29-37 imgs observed) with the Lord's transform rotation staying at 0° over 10 seconds — the 'no upside-down' regression fix is in place.

Formation screen (/app/frontend/app/army/formation.tsx) correctly ships all required testIDs: formation-preview, formation-stats, formation-power/types/command, formation-plus/minus/plus10/max/zero-<unit>, formation-qty-<unit>, suggest-formation-button, apply-suggestion-button, edit-suggestion-button, formation-preview-zoom-in/out. apply-formation-button is conditionally rendered (only when draft != current) per code at formation.tsx:103 — spec-correct.

ZoomPill uses default testID 'ui-zoom' on stack Screen headers and 'ui-zoom-bar' only on the ResourceBar row (ui/index.tsx:36 default, :217 override). Value persists across routes via uiScale store — Profile shows the same value via ui-zoom-profile.

Kingdom/Domain/War/Titan all use the shared ZoomPan component with testID prefixes 'kingdom-zoom' / 'domain-zoom' / 'war-zoom' / 'titan-zoom' → each auto-emits '-zoom-in/-zoom-out/-zoom-reset' children (ZoomPan.tsx:76-84). Tiles/buildings remain tappable after reset (building-castle sheet confirmed open + war-node-21 present).
